pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Red wire, 5 V: use VIN. Can reset the ESP32 if powered from USB alone under load

pins.name: SIG
pins.notes: Orange wire. 50 Hz PWM, 0.5 to 2.4 ms pulses

gotchas.text: A moving servo draws current peaks that can reset a USB-powered board. Power servos from a separate 5 V supply and connect the grounds.

source.title: Arduino Servo library reference
source.section: Servos draw considerable power; use a separate supply

sources.title: Tower Pro SG90 datasheet
sources.section: Wires: brown GND, red +5 V, orange PWM; 50 Hz, 1 to 2 ms
